model_binding_rule: Replay may report PARTIAL_UNVERIFIED/UNVERIFIED. Model-sensitive fresh evidence is non-promotable unless the private frozen execution manifest plus runtime receipt prove the predeclared observed model/reasoning/tools/environment binding; requested model text is not proof.
worker_write_rule: Read main pointer, then frozen generation G; write exactly reports/<cohort>/<role>.json on assigned ps/work/<cohort>/<role> branch. Whole-report HMAC-2. No main writes.
verifier_write_rule: Read all exact worker branches from G; write verification/<cohort>.json on ps/verify/<cohort> only. Record PRE_CI only; later exact-head supernova/report-admission is external evidence.
integrator_write_rule: Require MM06 safe refs and later supernova/report-admission=success on the exact verifier head; write ps/integrate/<cohort> only.
director_write_rule: Create one ps/consolidate/<cohort> PR from exact current main head only after verified integration. Require exact-head static-control/report-admission/transition-admission and CAS; no force/rebase/bypass.
research_rule: BIL00 only at 00:58 and 12:58, and only when an accepted open research lane exists. While T0 is unqualified, T0 transport/repository/admission closure is the only admissible research lane; downstream questions remain queued.
